content:
The **Sheepsquatch Shard** is a melee throwing weapon in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wild Appalachia* update.

## Gameplay[edit]

A Mysterious Quill of a Sheepsquatch, which has been wrapped in leather and formed into a deadly throwing knife. Some wire has been twisted into a makeshift hook on one end of the quill, making it easy to carry around multiple shards.

## Crafting[edit]

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| | | **Build at:** **Learn Method:** | | Sheepsquatch Shard (1) | 

## Locations[edit]

- Can be crafted at a Weapons Workbench.
- Sheepsquatch Shards can potentially be recovered after hitting and killing an enemy character. It cannot be recovered after hitting another player character.

Sheepsquatch Shards cannot be sold to vendors.
